payload.name: Cagnazzo
payload.summary: Shortly after engaging the boss, the arena will be surrounded by an AoE that will inflict Dropsy and deal damage-over-time to anyone who steps in it. *Stygian Deluge: Unavoidable party-wide damage. *Antediluvian: Spawns three sets of two bubbles across the arena, which will grow in size. When a bubble reaches maximum size, it will drop down as a large circular AoE with a brief indicator. The boss will also spawn a purple knockback AoE in the middle (Body Slam), which will kill anyone inside the AoE telegraph. This knockback cannot be prevented with knockback immune actions.
encounter_notes: Shortly after engaging the boss, the arena will be surrounded by an AoE that will inflict Dropsy and deal damage-over-time to anyone who steps in it.
*Stygian Deluge: Unavoidable party-wide damage.

*Antediluvian: Spawns three sets of two bubbles across the arena, which will grow in size. When a bubble reaches maximum size, it will drop down as a large circular AoE with a brief indicator. The boss will also spawn a purple knockback AoE in the middle (Body Slam), which will kill anyone inside the AoE telegraph. This knockback cannot be prevented with knockback immune actions.
*Hydraulic Ram: The boss will sequentially telegraph several line charge and circle AoEs which will disappear after a short time. It will then use AoE attacks in the order of the telegraphs.
*Hydrofall: Telegraphed stack AoE.
*Cursed Tide: The boss assigns various debuffs to players and becomes untargetable.
**File:Neap tide icon1.png Neap Tide: A point-blank AoE on the afflicted player when the debuff expires. Three players will receive this.
**File:Spring tide icon1.png Spring Tide: A stack AoE on the afflicted player when the debuff expires. One player will receive this.
**The boss will spawn four immobile Fearsome Flotsam which must be defeated before Cagnazzo's Power reaches 100, or the party will wipe.
**The party's debuffs will resolve, but they will be telegraphed with standard AoE indicators for several seconds before they resolve.
**Several telegraphed circular AoEs will also spawn.
*Tsunami: Party-wide damage after the adds phase. Heal through and mitigate.
*Voidcleaver: Four portals will spawn, each tethering to one player. These will periodically spawn telegraphed conal AoEs in the direction of the tethered player.
*Lifescleaver: Multiple telegraphed conal AoEs originating from the boss.
*Void Torrent: Line AoE tankbuster.

payload.name: Lyngbakr
payload.summary: * Sonic Bloop: Moderate damage tank buster. * Upsweep: Moderate damage to the entire party. Will cause any crystals formed to cast a wide or small AoE dependent on crystal size. *Tidal Breath: Lyngbakr turns around and casts a Large arena-wide AoE with high damage to anyone not behind them.
encounter_notes: * Sonic Bloop: Moderate damage tank buster.
* Upsweep: Moderate damage to the entire party. Will cause any crystals formed to cast a wide or small AoE dependent on crystal size.
*Tidal Breath: Lyngbakr turns around and casts a Large arena-wide AoE with high damage to anyone not behind them.

*Body Slam: Lyngbakr moves to the center of the area and unleashes a arena-wide AoE with moderate damage to the entire party and spawn crystals of various sizes that will cast an AoE dependent on the crystals size once Upsweep is cast.
*Floodstide: Casts AoE markers on all party members that do light damage

payload.name: Arkas
payload.summary: *Battle Cry: Moderate damage to party. Will spawn a dangerous AoE around arena size on subsequent casts, limiting its size. *Lightning Leap: Leaps in the opposite direction of the tank, releases a circular AoE and forms lightning lines on the floor that will explode. *Ripper Claw: Moderate damage tank buster
encounter_notes: *Battle Cry: Moderate damage to party. Will spawn a dangerous AoE around arena size on subsequent casts, limiting its size.
*Lightning Leap: Leaps in the opposite direction of the tank, releases a circular AoE and forms lightning lines on the floor that will explode.
*Ripper Claw: Moderate damage tank buster
*Spinning Claw: Releases a circular AoE from itself followed by lightning lines laid across the arena with a larger AoE than the ones from Lightning Leap.
*Lightning Rampage: Jumps 4 times, each time releasing a circular AoE and emitting lightning lines across the arena. The AoE surrounding the arena will disappear after the final set of AoEs.
*Lightning Claw: Stack marker AoE on a random player, dealing physical damage. Will electrify the area where the AoE hit, which will explode as a late telegraphed circle AoE.
*Electric Eruption: Party-wide magical damage and spawns three electrified spots on the arena that will explode as late telegraphed circle AoEs.

payload.name: Octomammoth
payload.summary: The Octomammoth is accompanied by its eight untargetable Tentacles that will attack independently. Additionally, the fight takes place on an irregularly-shaped arena, made up of five circular platforms connected by short bridges. *Tidal Roar: Low damage to the entire party. *Octostroke: Four of the five platforms will be flanked by a pair of Tentacles, which will cast Clearout, a short cone AoE that will, together, cover an entire platform. After the Clearout attack, the Tentacles will occasionally use Wallop, a line AoE through the center of the platform.
encounter_notes: The Octomammoth is accompanied by its eight untargetable Tentacles that will attack independently. Additionally, the fight takes place on an irregularly-shaped arena, made up of five circular platforms connected by short bridges.
*Tidal Roar: Low damage to the entire party.

*Octostroke: Four of the five platforms will be flanked by a pair of Tentacles, which will cast Clearout, a short cone AoE that will, together, cover an entire platform. After the Clearout attack, the Tentacles will occasionally use Wallop, a line AoE through the center of the platform.
*Vivid Eyes: A narrow ring AoE that passes through the center of all five platforms, plus their connectors. Get up next to the Octomammoth or as far away as you can to avoid.
*Saline Spit: Circle AoEs on all five platforms, leaving only the connectors between them safe.
*Tidal Breath: A wide AoE from the Octomammoth's front. Octomammoth will turn to one side, leaving roughly one and a half platforms to its flank safe.

*Telekinesis: The Octomammoth will telekinetically lift crystal formations on the outside of the arena with an orange tether. Once the crystals are lifted into the air, they will aim point-first toward the nearest platform and tether to it, before being thrust into it as a circle AoE that encompasses the entire platform.
*Breathstroke: Combines Octostroke and Tidal Breath into a single attack, except the "safe" platform will have a single Tentacle that further reduces the safe area to stand.
* Water Drop: Circle AoEs targeted on all players. Spread out and do not overlap them.

payload.name: Dark Elf
payload.summary: *Hexing Staves: Summons two staves on two tiles of the arena, each telegraphing a plus-shaped AoE, leading to: :*Ruinous Confluence: The staff line AoEs go off. Anyone hit will be inflicted with a cleansable Doom and a stack of File:Dark Whispers icon.png Dark Whispers that lasts indefinitely. The more stacks they have, the shorter the duration of the Doom if they are hit again. *Shadowy Sigil: Each tile will have a blue square or purple triangle, while an aura corresponding to one shape will emit from the boss, indicating which shape tiles are unsafe.
encounter_notes: *Hexing Staves: Summons two staves on two tiles of the arena, each telegraphing a plus-shaped AoE, leading to:

:*Ruinous Confluence: The staff line AoEs go off. Anyone hit will be inflicted with a cleansable Doom and a stack of File:Dark Whispers icon.png Dark Whispers that lasts indefinitely. The more stacks they have, the shorter the duration of the Doom if they are hit again.
*Shadowy Sigil: Each tile will have a blue square or purple triangle, while an aura corresponding to one shape will emit from the boss, indicating which shape tiles are unsafe.
*Hexing Staves / Sorcerous Shroud: Causes the two summoned staves to disappear. Players will need to remember their original locations.
*Void Dark II: Spread AoE telegraphs on all players.
*Ruinous Confluence: The staves will reappear and resolve their line AoEs, which will be very briefly telegraphed.
*Hexing Staves / Sorcerous Shroud: Now summons three staves that disappear.
*The boss will then use both Void Dark II and Shadowy Sigil before using Ruinous Confluence to detonate the three staves.
*Staff Smite: Tankbuster
*Abyssal Outburst: Party-wide damage

payload.name: Feather Ray
payload.summary: *Immersion: Party-wide magical damage. *Troublesome Tail: Gives each player a File:Nuisance icon.png Nuisance debuff with the combat message: . This debuff causes each player to mirror the boss's next attack. *Worrisome Wave: A telegraphed frontal conal AoE on a random player. Nuisance will cause each player will shoot a narrow untelegraphed conal AoE in front of them once their overhead timer expires. Players should avoid facing others.
encounter_notes: *Immersion: Party-wide magical damage.
*Troublesome Tail: Gives each player a File:Nuisance icon.png Nuisance debuff with the combat message: . This debuff causes each player to mirror the boss's next attack.

*Worrisome Wave: A telegraphed frontal conal AoE on a random player. Nuisance will cause each player will shoot a narrow untelegraphed conal AoE in front of them once their overhead timer expires. Players should avoid facing others.
*Hydro Ring: Telegraphed donut AoE that spawns a dangerous AoE at the edge of the arena, compressing it to a smaller circle.
*Blowing Bubbles: Numerous bubbles will originate from the boss and slowly move out, requiring players to dodge. The arena will return to normal when this attack ends.
*Bubble Bomb: Spawns multiple floating bubbles in a grid formation, leaving some empty spots.

*Rolling Current: A current from the east will shift all bubbles west by one position. Players will need to identify the empty spots considering the shift, because each bubble will explode in a late telegraphed point-blank AoE.
*Hydro Bomb then Troublesome Tail are used again, giving everyone File:Nuisance icon.png Nuisance.
*Trouble Bubbles: Each player will periodically shoot two slow-moving bubbles in front of where they are facing. Players must avoid being hit by others' bubbles.

payload.name: Damcyan Antlion
payload.summary: *Old Magic: Party-wide damage. *Duplicitous Battery: Telegraphs two sets of spiraling circle AoEs. Dodge into the first AoE when it resolves. *Forsaken Fount: Spawns four dark orbs (Aetheric Charges) through the middle of the arena. These will each explode in a point-blank AoE with a brief indicator.
encounter_notes: *Old Magic: Party-wide damage.
*Duplicitous Battery: Telegraphs two sets of spiraling circle AoEs. Dodge into the first AoE when it resolves.
*Forsaken Fount: Spawns four dark orbs (Aetheric Charges) through the middle of the arena. These will each explode in a point-blank AoE with a brief indicator.
*Duplicitous Battery is used again, but all players will also receive a spread AoE marker (Fallen Grace).
*Forsaken Fount is used again but now spawns three orbs.

*Contrapasso: Party-wide damage and causes each orb to split into two and move in the direction of the arrow telegraphs. Once the orbs finish moving, they will explode as point-blank AoEs. The middle (where the orbs originally were) is safe for this first set.
*Forsaken Fount / Contrapasso is used again but now spawns five orbs, and some may travel diagonally. The resulting AoE patterns will be in a 3x3 grid with one section safe.
*Antipodal Assault: Line AoE stack marker. The boss will charge to the wall.
*Hard Slash: A briefly telegraphed frontal cone AoE used when the boss is at the wall.
*Twilight Phase: Summons two sets of fangs around the boss, telegraphing a line AoE through where the fangs are pointing towards.
*Dark Impact: Tethers a random location and throws a dark sphere towards it, causing it to explode as a massive circular AoE. Move away.
*Death's Journey: A telegraphed point blank AoE and spawns 8 purple lines extending outwards, which indicate the centers of briefly telegraphed narrow conal AoEs.
*Arcane Edge: A telegraphed single-hit tankbuster.
payload.verification_notes: Nombre canónico corregido; valor legado: Durante

payload.name: Prime Punutiy
payload.summary: *Punutiy Press: Party-wide magical damage. *Hydrowave: Faces a player and uses a telegraphed conal AoE. *Resurface: Moves to the deep water at the west of the arena and uses a telegraphed persistent conal AoE that inflicts heavy. The boss will suck in debris and foliage. Afterwards multiple circle and line AoE telegraphs will spawn, requiring players to dodge. Finally, an untargetable Ihuykatumu Flytrap add will spawn and use a telegraphed donut AoE (Decay).
encounter_notes: *Punutiy Press: Party-wide magical damage.
*Hydrowave: Faces a player and uses a telegraphed conal AoE.

*Resurface: Moves to the deep water at the west of the arena and uses a telegraphed persistent conal AoE that inflicts heavy. The boss will suck in debris and foliage. Afterwards multiple circle and line AoE telegraphs will spawn, requiring players to dodge. Finally, an untargetable Ihuykatumu Flytrap add will spawn and use a telegraphed donut AoE (Decay).
*The boss immediately follows with another Hydrowave.

*Song of the Punutiy: Summons four untargetable adds: two Prodigious Punutiy, one Petit Punutiy, and one Punutiy. Each add will tether and mark one player, along with spawning an AoE telegraph. Two players will be hit with large circle AoEs (Punutiy Flop), one with a medium circle AoE (Punutiy Flop), and one with a conal AoE (Hydrowave). Spread out to avoid overlap. Afterwards, the adds will become targetable and should be killed.
*Shore Shaker: A telegraphed point-blank AoE followed by two telegraphed concentric donut AoEs.

payload.name: Drowsie
payload.summary: The boss will initially be sleeping but will awake when pulled. *Uppercut: Telegraphed tankbuster. *Sow: Scatters four seeds on the ground.
encounter_notes: The boss will initially be sleeping but will awake when pulled.
*Uppercut: Telegraphed tankbuster.
*Sow: Scatters four seeds on the ground.

*Drowsy Dance: Four telegraphed AoE circles appear, denoting locations where the seeds will sprout into untargetable Ihuykatumu Ivy adds. Each add will have an orange target ring denoting where they are facing. They will use Wallop a late telegraphed line AoE in front of them.
* The adds will enlarge and may also turn to face a different direction. They will use Wallop again, but the AoEs will be larger, making the safe spots smaller.
*Sneeze: Telegraphed wide conal AoE from the boss.

*Spit: Spawns numerous untargetable Red Clots, Blue Clots, and Green Clots. They will use Metamorphosis and each turn into a targetable Mimiclot add, which should be killed. The adds will spawn circle AoE telegraphs and unavoidable circle AoE markers on single players (Flagrant Spread).

payload.name: Apollyon
payload.summary: *Razor Zephyr: Faces a player and uses a telegraphed wide line AoE. *Blade: Telegraphed tankbuster dealing high damage. *Wild beasts emerge to defend their territory... Three untargetable adds appear: two Ihuykatumu Pumas and one Ihuykatumu Ocelot, which begin attacking the boss.
encounter_notes: *Razor Zephyr: Faces a player and uses a telegraphed wide line AoE.
*Blade: Telegraphed tankbuster dealing high damage.
*Wild beasts emerge to defend their territory... Three untargetable adds appear: two Ihuykatumu Pumas and one Ihuykatumu Ocelot, which begin attacking the boss.
*High Wind: Party-wide physical damage. Also kills the adds.
*The boss will begin eating the adds, empowering itself as indicated by the system message:

*Swarming Locust: Jumps three times around the edge of the arena, then uses four telegraphed line AoEs hitting most of the arena (Blades of Famine), creating safe spots to its southwest and southeast. The boss will then repeat this sequence.
*Levinsickle: Spawns four circle AoEs. Two of them will leave behind lingering lightning AoEs, which each spawn two sets of four telegraphed conal AoEs. Dodge into the first set.
*Thunder III: Spread marker on each player.
*Sandworms burst from the ground, drawn by the vibrations above... Three untargetable Ihuykatumu Sandworm adds appear.
*The boss uses High Wind again, killing the adds.
*The boss will begin eating the adds, empowering itself as indicated by the system message:
*Blade: Telegraphed AoE tankbuster dealing high damage and inflicting windburn. Then spawns a telegraphed donut AoE (Wind Sickle) on the tank.
*Razor Storm: Jumps to the wall and uses a wide telegraphed frontal cleave.

*Windwhistle: An untargetable Whirlwind add will spawn and begin rotating. Standing in the add will deal damage (Biting Wind) and knock the player back. While moving, it will telegraph 8 line AoEs (Cutting Wind) in a diffuse starburst pattern. There are 3 sets of AoEs in total.
*While the Whirlwind is active, the boss will use Razor Zephyr, followed by the Thunder III spread AoEs. These occur in between the Cutting Wind AoEs from the add.

payload.name: Ryoqor Terteh
payload.summary: *Frosting Fracas: Party-wide magical damage. Also causes a dangerous AoE to appear on the border of the arena. *Fluffle Up: Summons four untargetable Rorrlo Teh adds, each with an orange arrow indicator denoting where they are facing. Two of them will telegraph an AoE (Ice Scream) that covers a quadrant of the arena, followed by the other two. *Cold Feet: The boss will tether and freeze two adds, temporarily delaying their cast as indicated with The unfrozen adds will fire their AoEs first, so move in front of the frozen adds, then dodge back to the previously unsafe locations.
encounter_notes: *Frosting Fracas: Party-wide magical damage. Also causes a dangerous AoE to appear on the border of the arena.

*Fluffle Up: Summons four untargetable Rorrlo Teh adds, each with an orange arrow indicator denoting where they are facing. Two of them will telegraph an AoE (Ice Scream) that covers a quadrant of the arena, followed by the other two.

*Cold Feet: The boss will tether and freeze two adds, temporarily delaying their cast as indicated with The unfrozen adds will fire their AoEs first, so move in front of the frozen adds, then dodge back to the previously unsafe locations.

*Fluffle Up: Summons four untargetable Qorrlo Teh. Two of them will telegraph a large point-blank AoE (Frozen Swirl), followed by the other two. The boss will freeze two with Cold Feet again, which can be handled as before.

*Snowscoop: The boss summons multiple untargetable Snowball adds on the sides of the arena. These will telegraph two sets of line AoEs (Snow Boulder), while each player will receive a spread AoE marker (Sparkling Sprinkling). Players should dodge the line AoEs while not overlapping.

*Fluffle Up / Cold Feet: Now summons four untargetable Rorrlo Teh adds and four untargetable Qorrlo Teh adds, which function as before. This time, there will be a combination of the circle and line AoEs. To resolve this variation, stand in the quadrant with both a frozen Rorrlo Teh add facing into it and a frozen Qorrlo Teh add in its middle, making sure not to step in circle AoEs from other quadrants. Once the unfrozen adds finish casting, move into the visible safe space.

payload.name: Kahderyor
payload.summary: *Wind Unbound: Party-wide magical damage. *Crystalline Crush: Spawns a tower with a stack marker. The AoE will leave behind crystalline debris ( ) *Earthen Shot: Spread AoE on each player. The rock debris will also telegraph a large point-blank AoE with a yellow indicator.
encounter_notes: *Wind Unbound: Party-wide magical damage.
*Crystalline Crush: Spawns a tower with a stack marker. The AoE will leave behind crystalline debris ( )
*Earthen Shot: Spread AoE on each player. The rock debris will also telegraph a large point-blank AoE with a yellow indicator.
*Wind Shot: Donut AoE on each player. The rock debris will now telegraph a donut AoE with a green indicator. Players should all stack within the safe spot of the green donut.
*Crystalline Storm: Spawns three narrow line AoEs that leave behind purple rock debris.
*Wind Shot: Donut AoE on each player. The rock debris telegraph AoEs to their sides, leaving narrow lines in the purple debris safe.
*Earthen Shot: Spread AoE on each player. The rock debris will now telegraph wide line AoEs that leave narrow regions safe.

*Seed Crystals: Spread marker AoE on each player. Will begin encasing each player in crystal, applying File:Seed crystals icon.png Seed Crystals, which will become File:Seed crystals icon.png Crystal Burden upon expiration, preventing movement and slowing actions. If this effect expires, players will be inflicted with File:Seed crystals icon.png Crystallized and die. Players must destroy the Crystalline Debris on them to remove the debuffs.
*Sharpened Sights: Will grant a buff causing a telegraphed gaze attack (Eye of the Fierce) to be combined with its next two attacks.
**Stalagmite Circle: Telegraphed large point-blank AoE.
**Cyclonic Ring: Telegraphed donut AoE.

payload.name: Gurfurlur
payload.summary: *Heaving Haymaker: Party-wide magical damage. Also spawns a dangerous AoE around the arena. *Stonework: Spawns a small square AoE that will become an elemental image, initially either fire or water **Water: Telegraphed knockback and magical damage (Great Flood) from one side of the arena. Can be prevented with knockback immune actions.
encounter_notes: *Heaving Haymaker: Party-wide magical damage. Also spawns a dangerous AoE around the arena.
*Stonework: Spawns a small square AoE that will become an elemental image, initially either fire or water
**Water: Telegraphed knockback and magical damage (Great Flood) from one side of the arena. Can be prevented with knockback immune actions.
**Fire: Cascading square AoEs that eventually hit the entire arena (similar to Evil Earth in Eden's Gate: Sepulture). Also gives each player a spread AoE marker (Volcanic Drop).
*Sledgehammer: Three-hit line stack AoE. Heal and mitigate through.

*Arcane Stomp: Spawns multiple orbs that will begin moving towards the boss, applying a stack of damage up 2 Damage Up. If the boss receives too many stacks, its next attack will wipe the party. Players must soak the orbs to prevent them from reaching the boss, which will also grant a stack of damage up to the player.
*Enduring Glory: Party-wide magical damage. Will wipe the party if the boss has too many Damage Up stacks. Can use a tank limit break to survive if he has more than 6 stacks.

*Stonework: Now spawns a wind image in the middle the arena, telegraphing a knockback and dealing magical damage (Windswrath). Will also spawn four tornadoes that will move along a row of the arena, which should be dodged. Note that there will be a second knockback from the middle when the tornadoes are active. The knockbacks can be prevented with knockback immune actions.
*Stonework: Spawns both a fire and water image, causing both of their original attacks to be combined.

payload.name: Firearms
payload.summary: *Dynamic Dominance: Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE at the edge of the arena. *Mirror Maneuver: Spawns a blue mirror on one wall and a yellow orb on one corner. The boss will jump to a corner adjacent to the yellow orb and aim a telegraphed line AoE (Thunderlight Burst) at the mirror. This will cause it to be reflected (with a late telegraph) and hit the orb, causing it to explode as a massive late telegraphed point-blank AoE. Players can avoid by standing directly opposite the orb. *Ancient Artillery: Spawns an orange arrowkey-like glyph on two tiles. These indicate plus-shaped AoEs originating from them.
encounter_notes: *Dynamic Dominance: Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE at the edge of the arena.

*Mirror Maneuver: Spawns a blue mirror on one wall and a yellow orb on one corner. The boss will jump to a corner adjacent to the yellow orb and aim a telegraphed line AoE (Thunderlight Burst) at the mirror. This will cause it to be reflected (with a late telegraph) and hit the orb, causing it to explode as a massive late telegraphed point-blank AoE. Players can avoid by standing directly opposite the orb.
*Ancient Artillery: Spawns an orange arrowkey-like glyph on two tiles. These indicate plus-shaped AoEs originating from them.
*Emergent Artillery: The glyphs will expand in the direction of the arrows and explode.
*Pummel: Telegraphed physical tankbuster.
*Mirror Maneuver: Now spawns two blue mirrors and three yellow orbs. Thunderlight Burst will now be reflected twice. Players will need to identify the orb that will be hit and move away from it.

*Ancient Artillery: Now spawns three glyphs instead of two, leaving only one tile safe. In addition, each player will be given a spread marker (Thunderblight Flurry) that will resolve after the tiles explode.

payload.name: Maulskull
payload.summary: Please note that players may fall off the arena to their death. As the boss has multiple knockback attacks, this may be problematic for less experienced parties. Knockbacks can be prevented using Arm's Length, Surecast, or Inner Release. *Stonecarver ( ): One of the boss' fists will begin glowing and make a sound effect, followed by the other one, indicating two sequential late telegraphed half-room cleaves. *Skullcrush: Spawns a blue knockback AoE circle at the north or the arena. Also gives each player a spread marker. Players will need to be knocked back leaning towards the southwest or southeast to avoid being knocked off. Note: The knockback is fairly long, so stand as close to the blue circle as possible. Afterwards the spread AoEs will resolve (Destructive Heat).
encounter_notes: Please note that players may fall off the arena to their death. As the boss has multiple knockback attacks, this may be problematic for less experienced parties. Knockbacks can be prevented using Arm's Length, Surecast, or Inner Release.
*Stonecarver ( ): One of the boss' fists will begin glowing and make a sound effect, followed by the other one, indicating two sequential late telegraphed half-room cleaves.

*Skullcrush: Spawns a blue knockback AoE circle at the north or the arena. Also gives each player a spread marker. *Deep Thunder: A tower with a multi-hit stack marker appears. The entire party should soak the tower, causing three hits of physical damage.
*Ringing Blows: A combination of Stonecarver half-room cleaves and Skullcrush knockback AoE (without the spread markers). Players will need to be knocked back safely then avoid the half-room cleaves.
*Wrought Fire: Telegraphed AoE magical tankbuster.

*Colossal Impact: A blue knockback circle will spawn near a lower corner of the arena. In addition, a stack marker will spawn on a random player. The party will need to be knocked back to the opposite corner while remaining stacked (Building Heat)
*Colossal Impact is used again, but this time, each player will receive a spread marker instead.
*Ashlayer: Party-wide magical damage.

payload.name: Vanguard Commander R8
payload.summary: *Electrowave: Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE at the edge of the arena. *Enhanced Mobility: The boss will telegraph an AoE (Rapid Rotary) where it will move to the wall and drive in a circle around the arena, while brandishing a long blade of energy to one side, causing it to sweep across a quadrant of the arena, then either the middle of the arena or the corners of the room. **The long blade of energy will rotate with the boss as they turn to continue in the circular path. Depending on which direction the boss is going to rotate and the location of the blade (boss's left or boss's right), this essentially can be treated as a large circle AoE leaving the corners safe, or a large donut AoE leaving the middle safe.
encounter_notes: *Electrowave: Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE at the edge of the arena.

*Enhanced Mobility: The boss will telegraph an AoE (Rapid Rotary) where it will move to the wall and drive in a circle around the arena, while brandishing a long blade of energy to one side, causing it to sweep across a quadrant of the arena, then either the middle of the arena or the corners of the room.

**The long blade of energy will rotate with the boss as they turn to continue in the circular path. Depending on which direction the boss is going to rotate and the location of the blade (boss's left or boss's right), this essentially can be treated as a large circle AoE leaving the corners safe, or a large donut AoE leaving the middle safe.
*Dispatch: Summons four untargetable Vanguard Sentry R8 adds on one wall, leaving gaps in between them. They will use a late telegraphed line AoE (Rush).

*Dispatch: Now summons four untargetable Vanguard Sentry R8 adds on the four walls of the arena. They will begin flying in the air, telegraphing expanding circle AoEs and leaving one safe area each on the eastern and western walls.
*Dispatch / Electrosurge: Summons two sets of four adds on adjacent walls (causing a criss-cross of line AoEs), while each player receives a spread marker.

*Dispatch: Now summons eight adds on the wall. Four adds will begin telegraphing expanding circle AoEs, with the same safe areas as before. Halfway through this, other four adds will begin telegraphing another set of expanding AoE, with the sole safe zone being the center of the room. Dodge the first set by standing in the wall safe zone, then run to the center afterwards for the second set.

payload.name: Protector
payload.summary: *Electrowave: Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE around the edge of the arena. *Search and Destroy: Spawns untargetable Explosive Turret and Laser Turret adds, which will use numerous baited circle AoEs (Shock) and line AoEs (Homing Cannon) requiring the party to dodge continuously. These attacks appear very often and are largely centered on players, so simply keep moving to avoid them. Getting hit by these attacks deals damage but does NOT apply a stack of Vulnerability. *Fulminous Fence: Spawns six electric barriers in the middle of the arena that persist for the next mechanic. Any player who contacts these will take damage (Electrostatic Contact) and be inflicted with a potent paralysis for 10s that can be removed with Esuna.
encounter_notes: *Electrowave: Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE around the edge of the arena.

*Search and Destroy: Spawns untargetable Explosive Turret and Laser Turret adds, which will use numerous baited circle AoEs (Shock) and line AoEs (Homing Cannon) requiring the party to dodge continuously. These attacks appear very often and are largely centered on players, so simply keep moving to avoid them. Getting hit by these attacks deals damage but does NOT apply a stack of Vulnerability.

*Fulminous Fence: Spawns six electric barriers in the middle of the arena that persist for the next mechanic. Any player who contacts these will take damage (Electrostatic Contact) and be inflicted with a potent paralysis for 10s that can be removed with Esuna.
*Battery Circuit: Two rotating persistent conal AoEs, from opposite sides of the boss, and intermittent point-blank and circle AoEs that the party will need to dodge while avoiding the barriers.
*Rapid Thunder: Telegraphed magical tankbuster.
*Motion Sensor: Gives each player an File:Acceleration bomb icon.png Acceleration Bomb debuff for 12s. Players must not be moving when the debuff expires or they will take significant damage.

**The boss also summons several Laser Turret adds, which will telegraph sequential line AoEs laterally across the arena. Players will need to dodge these while considering when they need to stand still when their Acceleration Bomb debuff expires.
*Search and Destroy: Similar to before, but also spawns multiple electric barriers in a different configuration. Players will need to dodge the AoEs while avoiding the barriers.
*Tracking Bolt: Large spread marker AoE on each player.
*Heavy Blast Cannon: Line stack AoE marker on a random player, dealing magical damage.

payload.name: Zander the Snakeskinner
payload.summary: Phase 1 *Electrothermia: Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE at the edge of the arena. *Soulbane Saber: Telegraphed line AoE that will cause the half of the room it hits to begin glowing, telegraphing a delayed half-room AoE.
encounter_notes: Phase 1
*Electrothermia: Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE at the edge of the arena.
*Soulbane Saber: Telegraphed line AoE that will cause the half of the room it hits to begin glowing, telegraphing a delayed half-room AoE.
*Saber Rush: Telegraphed physical tankbuster.

*Soulbane Saber is then used four times in a row, each placed 90 degrees clockwise of the last. Two are placed initially, 90 degrees apart, leaving only a single quadrant of the room safe, while each player receives a spread AoE marker (Soulbane Shock). The first of the two half-room cleaves resolves before the AoE circle goes off, leaving a few seconds to move into the now cleared quadrant if needed for the AoE marker. This sequence occurs again, for the other two cardinal directions and including another set of AoE markers.
After reducing the boss's HP to 0, it will transform into a serpent-like creature.
Phase 2
*Syntheslean: Telegraphed frontal conal AoE.

*Syntheslither: The boss moves to the wall and spawns an orange squiggle through the arena, while four sword markers appear. The boss will travel down the squiggle and use an alternating left or right conal AoE when it reaches a marker. The direction of the cleave is determined based on the orientation of the curving line at the marker, e.g. if the line is going right, the boss will cleave right.

**The cleaves from this attack occur very quickly, and cover the entirety of the arena except a relatively small safe area next to the boss, on the opposite side of the line from the direction it initially curves. Stand "under" the first curve in the line to dodge the cleaves.
*Syntheslither is used immediately again.
*Shade Shot: Telegraphed magical tankbuster.

*Slitherbane Foreguard / Slitherbane Rearguard: Similar to Soulbane Saber from phase 1, but the boss also combos the initial line AoE with either a 180 degree front or rear cleave based on the name of the cast. Foreguard = front, Rearguard = back.
*The boss uses four of these attacks in sequence, rotating 90 degrees each time.
*Screech: Party-wide magical damage.

payload.name: Herpekaris
payload.summary: *Strident Shriek: Party-wide magical damage. *Vasoconstrictor: Spawns two poison globs in front of it, one left and one right. Standing in these will inflict File:Toxicosis icon1.png toxicosis damage-over-time for 15s. *Venomspill: The boss raises either its left or right leg, indicating which poison puddle will be hit, causing it to release multiple late telegraph circle AoEs (Pod Burst) in semi-random locations on its half of the room and partially covering the other half.
encounter_notes: *Strident Shriek: Party-wide magical damage.
*Vasoconstrictor: Spawns two poison globs in front of it, one left and one right. Standing in these will inflict File:Toxicosis icon1.png toxicosis damage-over-time for 15s.

*Venomspill: The boss raises either its left or right leg, indicating which poison puddle will be hit, causing it to release multiple late telegraph circle AoEs (Pod Burst) in semi-random locations on its half of the room and partially covering the other half.
**This attack will be used multiple times in succession.

**You should position yourself somewhere in the middle and immediately start moving to the safe side (edge of the arena of the safe side as AoEs can cover a bigger area). When the AoEs go off you should quickly start moving to the middle to be able to get to the other side for the next Venomspill. The last Venomspill will likely be on the same side as the previous one.
*Writhing Riot: Telegraphs three sequential AoEs: a 90-degree rear cone and two ~210-degree sweeps from its left or right.
*Poison Heart: Spread marker on all players. Used during Venomspill.
*Collective Agony: Line stack AoE marker dealing magical damage.
*Convulsive Crush: Telegraphed physical tankbuster.

payload.name: Deceiver
payload.summary: *Electrowave: Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE on the edge of the arena, inflicting paralysis on anyone who steps in it. *Bionic Thrash: The boss will hover its tentacle arms over two opposite quadrants of the arena, indicating late telegraph AoEs. *Initialize Androids: Spawns a row of untargetable Origenics Sentry G9 adds at the north wall. Adjacent adds will be blurry, while all adds will telegraph a line AoE (Synchroshot), together covering the arena. Players should move in front of the blurry adds because their AoEs will not go off.
encounter_notes: *Electrowave: Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE on the edge of the arena, inflicting paralysis on anyone who steps in it.
*Bionic Thrash: The boss will hover its tentacle arms over two opposite quadrants of the arena, indicating late telegraph AoEs.

*Initialize Androids: Spawns a row of untargetable Origenics Sentry G9 adds at the north wall. Adjacent adds will be blurry, while all adds will telegraph a line AoE (Synchroshot), together covering the arena. Players should move in front of the blurry adds because their AoEs will not go off.
*Afterwards, the adds will become targetable and should be killed.

*Initialize Turrets: Spawns four rectangular turrets on the west wall. Two turrets will be blurry, while all turrets will telegraph a line AoE, together covering the arena. Players should move in front of the blurry turrets because their AoEs will not go off.
**Immediately followed by the same attack with turret spawns in the opposite wall.

*Surge: Telegraphed horizontal knockback from the middle. Players should position to be knocked back into a non-blurry (real) turret to avoid hitting the border AoE. In addition, all players receive a spread AoE marker (Electray).

*Initialize Androids is used again, this time leaving only two blurry sentries. In addition, the boss will telegraph Bionic Thrash, leaving a smaller safe area from both the sentries and tentacle cleaves.

payload.name: Ambrose the Undeparted
payload.summary: *Psychic Wave: Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE on the edge of the arena. *Overwhelming Charge: Late telegraph 180 degree frontal cleave. Get behind. *Psychokinesis: One cage in the west side, and one cage from the east, will begin jiggling, indicating two late telegraph line AoEs leaving one row safe. The cages will release one Origenics Eyeborg and two Superfluity adds, which should be killed.
encounter_notes: *Psychic Wave: Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE on the edge of the arena.
*Overwhelming Charge: Late telegraph 180 degree frontal cleave. Get behind.

*Psychokinesis: One cage in the west side, and one cage from the east, will begin jiggling, indicating two late telegraph line AoEs leaving one row safe. The cages will release one Origenics Eyeborg and two Superfluity adds, which should be killed.

*Extrasensory Field: The arena will be divided into four blue quadrants, each with a different knockback arrow direction. The knockback is approximately half the long vertical of the arena. Players will need to position to avoid being knocked into the wall (by being pushed along the vertical) or use knockback immune.
*Voltaic Slash: Telegraphed physical tankbuster.
*Psychokinetic Charge: A combination of Extrasensory Fluid and Overwhelming Charge, where players must avoid being knocked back into the wall or the boss's subsequent frontal cleave.
*Electrolance: Massive telegraphed circle AoE at the back of the arena, causing a lance to appear.
*Psychokinesis: The boss spawns several red lines that briefly appear and disappear, telegraphing several line AoEs (Rush) from the lance.
*Psychokinesis with the cages is used again, but each player will also receive a spread AoE marker (Whorl of the Mind) dealing magical damage.
*Psychokinetic Charge is used again with another set of spread AoE markers.

payload.name: Antivirus X
payload.summary: The boss has an omnidirectional hitbox and does not move. *Immune Response: A telegraphed wide frontal conal AoE in front of the boss (leaving the sides or behind safe). Will also spawn a dangerous AoE around the arena. *Immune Response: A telegraphed wide AoE that now hits to the sides and behind (leaving the front safe).
encounter_notes: The boss has an omnidirectional hitbox and does not move.
*Immune Response: A telegraphed wide frontal conal AoE in front of the boss (leaving the sides or behind safe). Will also spawn a dangerous AoE around the arena.
*Immune Response: A telegraphed wide AoE that now hits to the sides and behind (leaving the front safe).
* Spawns five untargetable purple nodes (Interferon R and Interferon C) around the boss on the cardinals and intercardinals.

**A purple line will begin connecting the five nodes starting from the northwest or northeast, indicating the order in which they will resolve an AoE. Each node will also be given a green indicator: A plus indicates a plus-shaped AoE (Pathocross Purge) originating from the node, and a circle indicates a donut AoE (Pathocircuit Purge) originating from the node.
**Players must pay attention to the green indicator and dodge the AoEs in the order they resolve, as they have late ground telegraphs.
**During the last set of AoEs, the boss will begin casting another Immune Response (front or side/rear cleave).
*Quarantine: Telegraphed AoE tankbuster (Disinfection) and a stack marker on a random player. The tank should stay out while the other players stack together.
* Similar to before, but the boss will now use Immune Response twice as the node AoEs resolve. Players must consider the order of the mechanics and dodge accordingly.
**The order is: Node 1 > Node 2 + Immune Response > Node 3 > Node 4 > Node 5 > Immune Response
**Using Sprint is recommended.
*Cytolysis: Party-wide damage

payload.name: Gargant
payload.summary: *Chilling Chirp: Party-wide magical damage. *Almighty Racket: The boss will face a random player and use a late telegraphed 180 degree frontal cleave. Get behind. *The boss will then become untargetable, jump outside the arena, and begin crawling around. Take note of its location, as the sand falls will obscure it. When it stops (always behind a sand fall), it will re-emerge and use a late telegraphed wide line AoE charge (Aerial Assault) through the arena.
encounter_notes: *Chilling Chirp: Party-wide magical damage.
*Almighty Racket: The boss will face a random player and use a late telegraphed 180 degree frontal cleave. Get behind.

*The boss will then become untargetable, jump outside the arena, and begin crawling around. Take note of its location, as the sand falls will obscure it. When it stops (always behind a sand fall), it will re-emerge and use a late telegraphed wide line AoE charge (Aerial Assault) through the arena.
*AoE combinations
**Chilling Chirp will now summon two circle AoE telegraphs on opposite cardinals.
**Almighty Racket: Get behind.
**Three circle AoE telegraphs will then appear along with spread marker AoEs on each player (Sedimentary Debris) dealing magical damage. Spread out in the safe zone.

*Earthsong: Spawns two sets of untargetable Sand Sphere adds, each of which will use a telegraphed point-blank AoE (Sphere Shatter). The first set has 7 spheres and the second set has 6. The boss will jump outside again and being moving around, so players will need to keep track of its location while dodging the AoEs.
*Almighty Racket + Sedimentary Debris
*Trap Jaws: Telegraphed physical tankbuster.

payload.name: Amalgam
payload.summary: *Electrowave: Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE at the edges of the arena. *Disassembly: Amalgam divides into parts. Party-wide magical damage and the boss will divide into parts and become a smaller node. A line of electricity will begin outlining a triangle in half of the arena, indicating a late telegraph AoE. *Amalgam becomes whole again.
encounter_notes: *Electrowave: Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE at the edges of the arena.

*Disassembly: Amalgam divides into parts. Party-wide magical damage and the boss will divide into parts and become a smaller node. A line of electricity will begin outlining a triangle in half of the arena, indicating a late telegraph AoE.
*Amalgam becomes whole again.
*Centralized Current: An electric line will spawn through where the boss is facing, indicating a late telegraphed line AoE in that direction, leaving the sides of the boss's hitbox safe.
*Split Current: Similar to Centralized Current, but will now indicate two line AoEs hitting the sides of the boss.
*Disassembly is used again.

* A combination of the triangle AoE used before and a new attack in which three electric portals will spawn to the north, indicating line AoEs. Players must position to avoid both AoE sets at once. During this, each player will also receive a spread AoE marker (Static Spark).
*Amalgam becomes whole again.
*Amalgamight: Telegraphed physical tankbuster.
*Disassembly is used again, now also causing three sets of baited circle AoEs to appear beneath players. This is then followed with the same triangle/line AoEs and spread markers as before.
*Superbolt: Stack marker AoE dealing magical damage.
*Ternary Charge: A telegraphed point-blank AoE followed by two telegraphed concentric donut AoEs.

payload.name: Eliminator
payload.summary: *Disruption: Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE at the edges of the arena. *Partition: The boss's sword will begin glowing, indicating a late telegraphed half-room cleave at the right of the arena. *Reconfigured Partition: The boss's sword will switch direction and cleave the left of the arena.
encounter_notes: *Disruption: Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE at the edges of the arena.
*Partition: The boss's sword will begin glowing, indicating a late telegraphed half-room cleave at the right of the arena.
*Reconfigured Partition: The boss's sword will switch direction and cleave the left of the arena.

*Subroutine: The boss's floating hand (Elimination Claw) will move to west/east wall and begin charging energy, indicating a line AoE (Terminate) through where it is facing. In addition, the boss will cast another Reconfigured Partition, causing both AoEs to resolve at once, leaving two corners safe.

*Subroutine: Begins another set of AoEs. The boss's floating node (Elimbit) will converge lasers near the north/south wall, indicating a donut AoE (Halo of Destruction). Meanwhile, the boss will cast another Partition, leaving only half of the middle of the donut safe. After the AoEs resolve, each player is given a spread AoE marker (Electray) that deals magical damage and inflicts lightning resistance down Lightning Resistance Down II, making overlap lethal.
*Overexposure: Line stack marker on a random player, dealing magical damage.
*Subroutine: The boss becomes untargetable and summons six Lightning Generators that need to be killed before the Charge gauge reaches 100.
**During this sequence, players will need to dodge donut AoEs from the Elimbit and line AoEs from the Elimination Claw which have the same indicators as before.

**Later on, the Elimbit will reappear and use a telegraphed line AoE (Light of Salvation) hitting all players, so the party should spread. There will be another line stack marker as well although it is possible to skip this with enough DPS.
*The boss will become targetable again and use Holo Ark dealing high party-wide magical damage. This attack will wipe the party if the adds were not killed in time.

*Impact: A blue knockback circle will appear on one side. The knockback can be prevented with knockback immune actions. Meanwhile, each player will be targeted with Light of Salvation so should spread after the knockback.
*Elimination: Party-wide magical damage and spawns three sets of purple lines on the arena. These explode sequentially as line AoEs.

*Subroutine is used again but will now include all three previous AoEs: the boss's half-room cleave, the donut, and the hand line AoE. Players should resolve the first two and the move out of the hand line AoE, which will hit the initial safe spot from the donut.

payload.name: Barreltender
payload.summary: *Barbed Bellow: Party-wide magical damage. *Heavyweight Needles: Spawns multiple telegraphed conal AoEs, leaving gaps in between. Some gaps will be larger than others. Shortly before the cast resolves, the conal AoEs will expand and cover the smaller gaps, so players should stand in the middle of the largest gaps. This attack also spawns spines at the edges of the arena that will inflict bleed bleeding to anyone who steps in them. *Tender Drop: Drops multiple cacti on the arena. Most will have spines and a flower on top, while two will be naked.
encounter_notes: *Barbed Bellow: Party-wide magical damage.

*Heavyweight Needles: Spawns multiple telegraphed conal AoEs, leaving gaps in between. Some gaps will be larger than others. Shortly before the cast resolves, the conal AoEs will expand and cover the smaller gaps, so players should stand in the middle of the largest gaps. This attack also spawns spines at the edges of the arena that will inflict bleed bleeding to anyone who steps in them.
*Tender Drop: Drops multiple cacti on the arena. Most will have spines and a flower on top, while two will be naked.

*Barrel Breaker: Telegraphed radial knockback from the middle. Position to be knocked back towards a naked cactus, because each of the cacti will use a late telegraph point-blank AoE (Needle Storm), with the spiked and flowered cacti AoEs being larger (Needle Superstorm), leaving only some corners safe. Can also preposition near a naked cactus and use knockback resist.
*Succulent Stomp: Gives a random player a stack marker and jumps on them, dealing split physical damage.

*Prickly Left or Prickly Right: An initial half-room cleave telegraph in the direction of the cast that expands into a wide sweep hitting most of the arena except for a narrow conal region directly opposite the name of the cast.
*Tender Fury: Telegraphed physical tankbuster.

*Tender Drop is used again and combined with Heavyweight Needles, so players will need to position in the largest gaps that are close to a naked cacti. The cacti point-blank AoEs will go off a couple seconds after the conal AoEs.

payload.name: Anthracite
payload.summary: Players should note the circle and square holes on the arena and corresponding shaped holes in the walls, which will be used frequently for mechanics in this fight. *Anthrabomb: Spawns three black circle symbols and arrows, indicating where it will drop bombs that explode as large, late telegraphed circle AoEs. *Anthrabomb: Now spawns a yellow arrow leading towards a circle or square well, indicating it will throw a bomb in it, which will explode as late telegraphed line AoEs originating from the alternating wall holes of the same shape.
encounter_notes: Players should note the circle and square holes on the arena and corresponding shaped holes in the walls, which will be used frequently for mechanics in this fight.
*Anthrabomb: Spawns three black circle symbols and arrows, indicating where it will drop bombs that explode as large, late telegraphed circle AoEs.

*Anthrabomb: Now spawns a yellow arrow leading towards a circle or square well, indicating it will throw a bomb in it, which will explode as late telegraphed line AoEs originating from the alternating wall holes of the same shape.

*Anthrabomb: Now spawns two black arrows/circles and one yellow arrow, which is a combination of the first two usages of this ability. Players must dodge both the point-blank AoEs on the ground and the line AoEs from the wall holes at the same time.
*Carbonaceous Combustion: Party-wide magical damage.

*Carniflagration: Similar to the third usage of Anthrabomb (both black and yellow arrows) but used three times in a row. The next set of arrow telegraphs will appear shortly before the previous AoEs resolve, so players will need to consider the order of mechanics and dodge accordingly. Before the third set of AoEs resolve, each player will also be given a spread AoE marker (Anthrabomb).
*Burning Coals: Stack marker on a random player, dealing magical damage.
*Chimney Smack: Telegraphed magical tankbuster.

payload.name: Greatest Serpent of Tural
payload.summary: *Dubious Tulidisaster: Party-wide magical damage and spawns spikes at the edges of the arena that will inflict bleed bleeding to anyone who steps in them. *Bouncy Council: Spawns four untargetable clones, each of which will begin telegraphing a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line AoE (Misplaced Mystery) based on the blue arrows over its head. *Screes of Fury: Telegraphed AoE magical tankbuster.
encounter_notes: *Dubious Tulidisaster: Party-wide magical damage and spawns spikes at the edges of the arena that will inflict bleed bleeding to anyone who steps in them.
*Bouncy Council: Spawns four untargetable clones, each of which will begin telegraphing a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line AoE (Misplaced Mystery) based on the blue arrows over its head.
*Screes of Fury: Telegraphed AoE magical tankbuster.
*Bouncy Council: Now spawns four untargetable clones, each of which will begin telegraphing a point-blank AoE, as indicated by the spinning blue arrows. Move to the corner without a clone.

*Greatest Labyrinth: Pulls all players to the middle of the room. Spawns green arrows in different directions on the arena tiles (except for the middle 4 squares), purple X symbols on three corners, and a blue O symbol on one corner tile. Each player will receive link= Greatest Curse that lasts for 15s. They must cleanse this debuff before it naturally expires or they will instantly die. To cleanse the debuff, players must use the green arrows to transport them to the corner O tile. Touching the X tiles will inflict poison poison, dealing high damage-over-time. The symbols will disappear after the mechanic resolves.
**The easiest way to solve this is to locate the blue O tile corner work backwards, following the arrows that point to it until they reach the center of the room to find the safe path.
**Once you have reached the blue O tile, you may safely return to the center of the labyrinth and start attacking the boss once more, without waiting for the maze to disappear.
*Bouncy Council: Now spawns four clones in the 4 quadrants of the room. Two of these, always adjacent to each other, will use point-blank AoEs, while the other two use line AoEs.

*Moist Summoning: Spawns an untargetable Great Serpent of Tural add, which will use three sequential stack AoEs on a random player (Mighty Blorp) dealing physical damage and leaving behind a puddle. Each new puddle will be smaller than the last. Players who linger in this puddle for too long will receive sludge sludge for 15s, dealing damage-over-time. The add will disappear after this mechanic.

*Greatest Flood: Telegraphed radial knockback from one corner. Position to be knocked back while avoiding the lingering puddles, or use a knockback immunity ability. The puddles will disappear after this mechanic.

*Bouncy Council: Now spawns five clones, 4 in the quadrants of the room and one in the center. Two adjacent quadrant ones will use a point-blank AoE, while the other two quadrant ones and the center one will use line AoEs.
*Great Torrent: Spawns numerous sequential AoEs that cover the arena. Move into the first when it goes off. Also gives each player a spread AoE marker.

payload.name: His Royal Headness Leonogg I
payload.summary: *Malicious Mist: Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE at the edge of the arena. *Falling Nightmare: Spawns a floating head above each player's location. After a few seconds, the head will drop from its spawn location (in a small late telegraphed circle AoE) and inflict File:Benoggined icon.png Benoggined for 10s, preventing anyone hit from taking actions and decreasing movement speed. Move away from the heads when they spawn to avoid. *Team Spirit: Summons several dolls around the arena.
encounter_notes: *Malicious Mist: Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE at the edge of the arena.

*Falling Nightmare: Spawns a floating head above each player's location. After a few seconds, the head will drop from its spawn location (in a small late telegraphed circle AoE) and inflict File:Benoggined icon.png Benoggined for 10s, preventing anyone hit from taking actions and decreasing movement speed. Move away from the heads when they spawn to avoid.
*Team Spirit: Summons several dolls around the arena.

*Spirited Charge: The dolls will begin running through the arena, aiming at certain players. Once each doll reaches the other side, it will run through the arena a second time. Anyone who touches them will be inflicted with bind for 5s, making them vulnerable to subsequent avoidable AoEs, and then inflicted with File:Benoggined icon.png Benoggined for 10s. This attack is combined with other mechanics throughout the fight, causing a very chaotic sequence of dodging multiple AoEs and dolls at once.
**The first time the dolls move, they will aim for the furthest player from them. The second time they move, they will aim for the closest player.

**Two ranged players can bait the dolls by standing near the north and south side of the arena, then move clockwise to dodge until the dolls reach the opposite wall. The dolls should aim for them again, so they can now dodge towards the middle of the arena.
Spirited Charge 1.jpg|Spirited Charge baits, step 1 (Credits to @The_Doddler)
Spirited Charge 2.jpg|Step 2

*Evil Scheme: Four exaflare AoE telegraphs will spawn in the middle, 90 degrees away from each other. This is followed by another set of exaflares in the previously empty areas. Wait for the first set of exaflares to go off twice then move into the spawn locations of the first set.
**Note that these AoEs resolve while the dolls are still running around, so it is important to not touch them.

*Team Spirit and Spirited Charge are used again. In addition, two players will receive Looming Nightmare, a five-hit series of chasing circle AoEs. Players must avoid both the AoEs and the dolls at once.

*Team Spirit and Spirited Charge are used again. In addition, the boss will telegraph three sets of sequential conal AoEs that cover the arena (Scream). Players must avoid both the AoEs and the dolls at once. While the dolls are still running around, two players will receive Looming Nightmare.
*Falling Nightmare is used again but now summons heads at various locations above the arena, which should be dodged accordingly.

payload.name: Jack-in-the-Pot
payload.summary: *Troubling Teacups: Spawns four teacups at the edges of the arena on the cardinals. *Tea Awhirl: A ghost appears, tethers, and possesses one teacup. Afterward, all of the tea cups will begin spinning multiple times, moving inwards and outwards to attempt to disorient players. Players must keep track of the originally tethered teacup during this sequence because it will explode as a large late telegraphed AoE (Tricksome Treat). *Troubling Teacups: Now spawns eight teacups, two per cardinal.
encounter_notes: *Troubling Teacups: Spawns four teacups at the edges of the arena on the cardinals.

*Tea Awhirl: A ghost appears, tethers, and possesses one teacup. Afterward, all of the tea cups will begin spinning multiple times, moving inwards and outwards to attempt to disorient players. Players must keep track of the originally tethered teacup during this sequence because it will explode as a large late telegraphed AoE (Tricksome Treat).
*Troubling Teacups: Now spawns eight teacups, two per cardinal.

**Tea Awhirl: Two teacups will now be possessed by ghosts. Similar to before, players must keep track of where the possessed teacups end up because both of them will explode. The two tethered teacups will either be 90 or 180 degrees apart, so the final set of AoEs will also spawn in the safe offset.

** An easy solution to this mechanic is to observe just the first teacup (if possessed cups are next to each other) or any of them if they are on opposite sides. When the cups start to stop go 90 degrees ahead of the observed cup (where another, safe cup will be present) on the edge of the encounter area.
*Toiling Teapots: Spawns 13 teacups, nine on the cardinals/center and four on the intercardinals.

**Kettles will appear over some cups and begin pouring a purple liquid into them, causing them to overflow and create an expanding puddle AoE. While these expand, more cups will be filled and overflow to create more puddles, followed by the remaining cups. Anyone who contacts a puddle will receive damage (Mad Tea Party) and be inflicted with bleeding damage-over-time for 15s.

payload.name: Lindblum Zaghnal

payload.name: Overseer Kanilokka

Standing in this will inflict a Heavy, a 6-second Bleeding and 30-second Damage Down. *Numerous orange-brown curved line AoE telegraphs will appear and resolve sequentially, which should be dodged. *Phantom Flood: A telegraphed donut AoE that will spawn a persistent AoE, compressing the arena into a small circle.

payload.name: Lunipyati
payload.summary: *Raging Claw: The boss will face a random player and use a late telegraphed, multi-hit 180 degree cleave AoE. Move behind. *Leporine Loaf: Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE at the edge of the arena, compressing it into a circle. *The boss will remain stationary and not auto-attack while both of the following mechanic sets resolve, in a random order.
encounter_notes: *Raging Claw: The boss will face a random player and use a late telegraphed, multi-hit 180 degree cleave AoE. Move behind.
*Leporine Loaf: Party-wide magical damage and spawns a dangerous AoE at the edge of the arena, compressing it into a circle.
*The boss will remain stationary and not auto-attack while both of the following mechanic sets resolve, in a random order.
Curved orange lines

*Four orange curves will spawn from the middle, followed by four more orange curves on the previously empty areas. These denote fast-moving, late telegraphed circle AoEs (Leaping Earth) that will spiral outward following each curve.
*This attack is used again but with a different pattern of orange curves.
*Finally, a long orange spiral will originate from the boss, indicating circle AoEs that will spiral outwards. Start at the wall and dodge into the middle layer of AoEs.
Arrows

*Three red curving arrows will appear, indicating the trajectory of sandworms that spawn. Circle AoE telegraphs (Boulder Dance) will spawn at the origin of each arrow. The head of the arrow will be the location of a late telegraphed circle AoE, so dodge into a region that does not any contain arrows. These AoEs will persist for a few seconds.

*The arrow telegraphs will appear again in a different pattern, leaving the four cardinals or intercardinals at the wall safe. In addition, each player will receive a spread AoE marker (Jagged Edge) dealing magical damage. These resolve shortly after the sandworm AoEs dissipate.
After one mechanic set is finished, the other set will resolve.
*Crater Carve: The boss will destroy the middle of the arena (with a late AoE telegraph), leaving behind a ring-shaped region. Falling into the hole will result in death.

**Players should be careful with gap closer actions during the remainder of the battle. Using them to attempt to traverse the hole, or when the boss jumps to a different part of the room, will cause the player to fall to their death.
*The boss will gain the File:Directional disregard icon1.png Directional Disregard debuff, making its hitbox omnidirectional.

*Beastly Roar: Spawns a proximity AoE telegraph dealing magical damage at the boss's feet. Players must move to the opposite side of the arena to mitigate. When it resolves, it will additionally spawn a fast-moving set of circle AoEs that will travel clockwise or counterclockwise along the ring, so players must dodge in the opposite direction. Anyone hit by these will be temporarily stunned and knocked up. Using Sprint is recommended. The AoEs will complete slightly less than one full rotation.
**For uptime, tanks may opt to remain in melee range and use an invulnerability cooldown, although it may not be possible to dodge the rotating AoEs that temporarily stun.

*The boss will jump to a new location and use Raging Claw, so get behind it. Can use its hitbox flank arrows to guide. Each player will also receive a Jagged Edge spread marker, followed by one player receiving a stack marker (Turali Stone IV).
*Sonic Howl: Party-wide magical damage
*Slabber: Telegraphed magical tankbuster.
*Mechanics for the ring arena phase then repeat until the boss is defeated.

payload.name: Xande
payload.summary: Ocupa los círculos de orbes, destruye attractors, comparte los marcadores y usa Null Gravity para evitar Ancient Quaga.
payload.summary_es: Ocupa los círculos de orbes, destruye attractors, comparte los marcadores y usa Null Gravity para evitar Ancient Quaga.
encounter_notes: Xande should be tanked in the center of the arena. He has the standard "don't stand in this" mechanics, including a targeted AoE which deals about 2k damage. While not dangerous, a DPS can potentially be one-shotted if two are overlapping each other and the DPS is still standing in them. He also has Knuckle Press, which is centered on him, and deals moderate damage with a severe knockback. Melee must watch out for this.

Aetherochemical Explosion - Every now and then Xande creates golden orbs with a small golden radius around them. You have about 10-15 seconds before they detonate, so the raid should be fairly well spread in anticipation of this. They explode and deal about 500 damage per explosion if not neutralized, and since he spawns about a dozen at a time, this is a good way to lose a chunk of your raid if nobody is paying attention. To stop the explosion, simply have a person stand within the golden radius. This causes the orb to hit that person for about 50 damage upon detonation, rather than blasting the entire raid for ten times that damage.

At 70%, Xande teleports out of the arena and lounges on his throne while calling down meteors on your raid. This is the first intermission. 3 Attractors will appear on the edge of the arena. They must be killed quickly to prevent meteorfall. Additionally a giant attractor appears in the center. The entire raid should this one together once the three attractors on the fringes have been destroyed. If the small meteors land they cause heavy raid wide damage, if the big one lands it is a wipe.

Once Xande reappears, phase 2 begins. He now has a new attack where one person from each party gains a stack up marker on them. This expires after about 15 seconds and deals close to 10k damage, split evenly amongst everyone standing in it, so each party should stack up close to Xande but without overlapping the circles to soak. A null gravity zone is left behind upon detonation which lets you float. This is important because ...

Immediately after detonation, Xande will cast Ancient Quaga. The ability deals more than 5k damage to everyone in the raid. The attack is nullified by floating. When Xande begins casting Ancient Quaga, everyone should move into a null gravity zone. Immediately after Ancient Quaga, AoEs will be left under random party members, so scatter to avoid massive damage.
Xande retains golden orbs in this phase.

Intermission 2 - Same as intermission 1, except at 40% health. Only each group now has to deal with two small meteor attractors instead of just one. Not too difficult. Since no damage is going out in entire intermission, healers should catch up on healing and join in the damage.

After that it's the same straight burn to death. Xande retains Golden Orbs and Ancient Quaga from phase 2, and also starts casting Ancient Quake every now and then, which deals light raidwide damage. But you should be able to down him smoothly at this point in time.

It will then spawn six linked clones of itself in a hexagon, all with the same animation. The clones will then begin disappearing in a clockwise or counterclockwise pattern. *Entropic Sphere: Party-wide magical damage.

*Coordinate March: The boss will tether two tiles with magenta tethers and the edge of the south two tiles with blue tethers.
